decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera sits close to the core offer, has its own web page, and fits the firm's announced direction, so the sunk development and qualification costs and the public commitment favour keeping it.
A modular camera line with several models is a heavily invested, visibly promoted product that is central to the firm's push toward flexible, compact sensors, so management will persist with it.

The space situational awareness suite extends the firm into a growing field and is publicly showcased, so any slow early uptake will be blamed on long space procurement cycles rather than taken as failure.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, so it is less visible, but it is central to the docking and small-satellite strategy and space qualification is costly, so the firm is likely to stay committed.
